definitions.text_mt: Għawm: nom verbali ta' 'għam'. l-att li wieħed jgħum fl-ilma

usage_examples.maltese: L-għawm huwa sport tajjeb għas-saħħa.
usage_examples.english: Swimming is a good sport for health.

usage_examples.maltese: Jien inħobb l-għawm fil-baħar.
usage_examples.english: I love swimming in the sea.

definitions.text_en: a swim, an instance of swimming
definitions.text_mt: Għawma: ħin imqatta' jgħum. attività ta' għawm

usage_examples.maltese: Ħadt għawma sabiħa llum fil-bajja.
usage_examples.english: I had a nice swim today at the beach.

usage_examples.maltese: Kull filgħodu nieħu għawma qabel ix-xogħol.
usage_examples.english: Every morning I take a swim before work.

definitions.text_mt: Għawnelli: jidhirli, donni (alternattiva ortografika ta' 'għenelli')

usage_examples.maltese: Għawnelli li l-ikel lest.
usage_examples.english: It seems to me that the food is ready.

usage_examples.maltese: Għawnelli li llum se tagħmel ix-xemx.
usage_examples.english: It seems to me that today it will be sunny.

definitions.text_mt: Għawseġ: siġra tax-xewk tal-familja Solanaceae, b'weraq dojoq u fjuri vjola, li tikber f'artijiet niexfa (Lycium europaeum)

usage_examples.maltese: Il-għawseġ jikber mal-ġnub tat-toroq fl-artijiet niexfa.
usage_examples.english: The European box-thorn grows along roadsides in dry areas.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-frott tal-għawseġ huwa aħmar u żgħir.
usage_examples.english: The fruit of the European box-thorn is red and small.

definitions.text_mt: Għawwas: inħares lejn xi ħaġa b'għajn waħda magħluqa jew billi dawwar ir-ras b'mod f'daqqa. inħares b'għajn mibruma

usage_examples.maltese: Għawwas lejja b'għajnejh u ma qal xejn.
usage_examples.english: He looked askew at me with his eyes and said nothing.

definitions.text_mt: Għawwed: jgħid xi ħaġa diversi drabi, jirrepeti
Għawwed: jirrepeti azzjoni, jagħmel xi ħaġa mill-ġdid

usage_examples.maltese: Għawwed l-istorja diversi drabi biex niftakarha.
usage_examples.english: He repeated the story several times so I would remember it.

usage_examples.maltese: Jekk ma tifhemx, ngħawwedlek.
usage_examples.english: If you do not understand, I will repeat it for you.

definitions.text_en: to make something float, make someone swim
definitions.text_mt: Għawwem: iġegħel lil xi ħaġa tibqa' f'wiċċ l-ilma. iġegħel lil xi ħadd jgħum

usage_examples.maltese: Għawwem il-flixkun fl-ilma biex ma jegħreqx.
usage_examples.english: He made the bottle float in the water so it would not sink.

usage_examples.maltese: Ommi għawwmitni meta kont żgħir.
usage_examples.english: My mother taught me to swim when I was young.

definitions.text_mt: Għawweġ: jitwi xi ħaġa, jagħmilha tgħawweġ
Għawweġ: jgħawweġ il-verità jew fatti, jbiddilhom

definitions.text_en: to speak with a village accent
definitions.text_mt: Għawweġ: jitkellem b'aċċent rażżli jew b'djalett tal-kampanja

usage_examples.maltese: Għawweġ il-wajer biex jagħmel ganċ.
usage_examples.english: He bent the wire to make a hook.

usage_examples.maltese: Tgħawwiġx il-verità biex taħbi l-iżball tiegħek.
usage_examples.english: Do not contort the truth to hide your mistake.

usage_examples.maltese: Jgħawweġ meta jitkellem għax trabba fil-kampanja.
usage_examples.english: He speaks with a village accent because he grew up in the countryside.

definitions.text_mt: Għawwiem: persuna li tgħum, speċjalment bħala sport jew b'mod professjonali

usage_examples.maltese: Huwa għawwiem tajjeb ħafna u rebaħ diversi kompetizzjonijiet.
usage_examples.english: He is a very good swimmer and has won several competitions.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-għawwiema qasmu l-kanal bil-qawwa kollha.
usage_examples.english: The swimmers crossed the channel with all their strength.

definitions.text_mt: Għawġ: ħaġa mibruma jew mgħawġa. nuqqas ta' dritt jew rettitudni
Għawġ: diffikultà, problemi, inkwiet

usage_examples.maltese: Dan il-bord għandu ħafna għawġ mhux meħtieġ.
usage_examples.english: This board has a lot of unnecessary crookedness.

usage_examples.maltese: Ma rridx nidħol f'għawġ mal-ġirien.
usage_examples.english: I do not want to get into trouble with the neighbours.

definitions.text_mt: Għax: minħabba li, la darba, għaliex

usage_examples.maltese: Ma ġiex għax kien marid.
usage_examples.english: He did not come because he was ill.

usage_examples.maltese: Ħadt il-parasol għax kien hemm ix-xemx qawwija.
usage_examples.english: I took the umbrella because the sun was strong.

definitions.text_mt: Għaxar mitt elf: numru ta' valur miljun (użat fil-passat)

usage_examples.maltese: Qabel kienu jgħidu għaxar mitt elf minflok miljun.
usage_examples.english: In the past they used to say għaxar mitt elf instead of million.

definitions.text_mt: Għaxart elef: numru ta' valur għaxart elef (10,000)

usage_examples.maltese: Kien hemm għaxart elef ruħ fl-istadju.
usage_examples.english: There were ten thousand people in the stadium.

usage_examples.maltese: Ħallas għaxart elef ewro għal dik il-karozza.
usage_examples.english: He paid ten thousand euros for that car.

definitions.text_mt: Għaxi: dgħajjef, mingħajr saħħa, li għandu tqalligħ jew dewlin

usage_examples.maltese: Wara l-marda, kien għaxi u ma setax jaħdem.
usage_examples.english: After the illness, he was faint and could not work.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-mara kienet għaxija wara li ġarret il-piż tqil.
usage_examples.english: The woman was faint after carrying the heavy load.

definitions.text_mt: Għaxi: nom verbali ta' 'għoxa'. l-att li wieħed jagħxi

usage_examples.maltese: L-għaxi jiġi meta l-ġisem ikun għajjien wisq.
usage_examples.english: Fainting comes when the body is too tired.

definitions.text_mt: Għaxqa: pjaċir kbir, ferħ, delizzju. xi ħaġa li tagħti pjaċir

usage_examples.maltese: Kienet għaxqa tisma' l-kant tagħha.
usage_examples.english: It was a delight to hear her singing.

usage_examples.maltese: L-għaxqa li ħassejt ma tistax tiddeskrivi bil-kliem.
usage_examples.english: The pleasure I felt cannot be described in words.

definitions.text_mt: Għaxra: numru li jiġi wara disgħa u qabel ħdax. l-għadd ta' għaxart unitajiet (10) (forma assoluta)

usage_examples.maltese: Għaxra huma biżżejjed għal-laqgħa.
usage_examples.english: Ten are enough for the meeting.

usage_examples.maltese: Iż-żraben jiswew għaxra lira.
usage_examples.english: The shoes cost ten pounds.

definitions.text_mt: Għaxwa: telf f'daqqa tal-kuxjenza, ġmiegħ. stat ta' ħass ħażin

usage_examples.maltese: Waqa' fl-għaxwa minħabba s-sħana.
usage_examples.english: He fell into a swoon because of the heat.

usage_examples.maltese: L-għaxwa damet ftit minuti biss.
usage_examples.english: The fainting fit lasted only a few minutes.

definitions.text_mt: Għaxxa: iġegħel lil xi ħadd jitħassar u jaqa' fl-għaxwa

definitions.text_en: to cause someone to laugh heartily
definitions.text_mt: Għaxxa: iġegħel lil xi ħadd jidħaq b'qalbu
Għaxxa: jgħajjat, isabbat. iġegħel lil xi ħadd isabbat

usage_examples.maltese: L-aħbar ħażina għaxxatu.
usage_examples.english: The bad news made him faint.

usage_examples.maltese: Iċ-ċajta kienet daqshekk umoristiċi li għaxxatna bid-daħk.
usage_examples.english: The joke was so funny that it made us laugh heartily.

usage_examples.maltese: L-ikel kien daqshekk ħelu li għaxxa ħalqu.
usage_examples.english: The food was so sweet that it cloyed his palate.

definitions.text_mt: Għaxxaq: jagħti pjaċir kbir, iferraħ. iġegħel lil xi ħadd igawdi

usage_examples.maltese: Il-vjaġġ għaxxaq lil kulħadd fl-iskola.
usage_examples.english: The trip delighted everyone at school.

definitions.text_mt: Għaxxex: jibni bejta (tajra)
Għaxxex: jitkebbeb, jiddewwel, jingħataf
Għaxxex: jiddgħajjef, jitlef is-saħħa, jixxejjen

usage_examples.maltese: Il-ħamiema għaxxet fil-bejt tad-dar.
usage_examples.english: The pigeon nested on the roof of the house.

usage_examples.maltese: Il-qtates għaxxex ma' ħdejn in-nar.
usage_examples.english: The cat cuddled up near the fire.

usage_examples.maltese: Wara x-xitwa twila, is-siġar bdew jgħaxxu.
usage_examples.english: After the long winter, the trees began to weaken.

definitions.text_mt: Għaġeb: stagħġib, sorpriża kbira, mistagħġeb

usage_examples.maltese: Kien għaġeb li rajh wara tant snin.
usage_examples.english: It was a surprise to see him after so many years.

usage_examples.maltese: L-għaġeb tiegħi kien kbir meta smajt l-aħbar.
usage_examples.english: My astonishment was great when I heard the news.

definitions.text_mt: Għaġen: iħallat dqiq ma' ilma, ħmira u ingredjenti oħra biex jagħmel għaġina

usage_examples.maltese: Ommi għaġnet il-ħobż illum filgħodu.
usage_examples.english: My mother kneaded the bread this morning.

usage_examples.maltese: Biex tagħmel il-pizza, l-ewwel trid tagħġen id-dqiq.
usage_examples.english: To make pizza, you first have to knead the flour.

definitions.text_mt: Għaġin: nom verbali ta' 'għaġen'. l-att tat-taħlit tal-għaġina
Għaġin: ikel magħmul mid-dqiq bħal spagetti, makkruni u xorta

usage_examples.maltese: Il-għaġin tal-ħobż jeħtieġ ħin biex jistrieħ.
usage_examples.english: The kneading of the bread needs time to rest.

usage_examples.maltese: Illum se nieklu għaġin bit-tadam u l-basal.
usage_examples.english: Today we will eat pasta with tomato and onion.

definitions.text_mt: Għaġina: taħlita ta' dqiq, ilma, ħmira u melħ, lesta biex ttektek u tinkeb

usage_examples.maltese: L-għaġina hija lesta biex tittektek.
usage_examples.english: The dough is ready to be rolled out.

usage_examples.maltese: Ħallat l-għaġina sew qabel ma ttektekha.
usage_examples.english: Mix the dough well before rolling it out.
